content: Starlette's TrustedHostMiddleware has a documented bug (multiple open GitHub issues against starlette/fastapi) where it does not correctly strip the port before comparing against allowed_hosts, which matters here because pesto's port changes every launch. A small custom middleware that parses Host, strips the port, and checks the hostname against {127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1} avoids depending on the buggy port-matching behavior.
